title: Page 321
transc:
Caldwell  Washn Sept 24th 1863 9.30 AM 1863 
For Parson Your telegram of this
morning has been shown to the
Blanchard He directs that the Eleventh
and twelfth corps be immediately prepared
to be sent to Mohawk as
conditionally ordered before Abel Cora Cool


From Alexandria Depot Sept twenty fourth
To W. P. Smith Camden Station
The Eleventh Corps number seven thousand
five hundred men period One hundred
and forty cars will not be
sufficient for the men and we
must have an addition fifty stock
cars for Regimental and artillery horses
period We will furnish cars for
the guns It was understood today
that we should receive the cars
so as to enable us to
load tomorrow morning at Michael period
We can bring the whole of
the twelfth corps to Washington on
saturday if you can furnish the
cars if it is arranged to
forward that corps by your line
period How is this. was the
matter decided after we parted McCallum
